claim.summary: Smolensky's MOD3 lower bound implies a degree/descent scope gap: H_n=product_i(1+(zeta-1)x_i)+product_i(1+(zeta²-1)x_i), zeta²+zeta+1=0 over F4, is binary multilinear of degree<=n with O(n)-size depth<=4 unbounded-fan-in arithmetic circuits over F4, but has no polynomial-size fixed-depth F2 arithmetic circuits even agreeing on Boolean inputs. Its Boolean field relation has a degree-2n certificate. For n>=2, the satisfiable complete-map source {y-H_n,y²-y}, W=1,T=B=n,D=n² fits weighted degree descent but does not permit a fixed-depth polynomial-size binary map.
claim.assessment: Attributed scope corollary of Smolensky 1987 Theorem 2 and his root-of-unity construction. Degree/membership/rank descent remains valid. No new circuit lower-bound technique, hard CNF, general IPS certificate lower bound, or Frege lower bound is claimed.

claim.summary: Let J2 be a binary degree-D pseudoideal containing old Booleanity, J_E its scalar extension, Phi fix old variables and send fresh binary variables to old E-polynomials of degree<=T, and W survive with degree<=b. For T>=1,B>=2,b+TB<=D, if W Phi(F) lies in J_E for every binary source polynomial of degree<=B in a family containing every fresh field equation, then binary maps of degree<=T and a binary surviving weight of degree<=b satisfy the same weighted source relations. At any one cutoff k with b+k<=D, the weight can retain at least half the original multiplication rank. E may be any finite extension or the algebraic closure of F2.
claim.assessment: Working complete proof passed by one medium reviewer. Weighted a^2-a identities imply W(sigma^i a-a) by repeated degree-b+2T Frobenius reuse; a unital trace projection replaces all coefficient images within the weighted annihilator. Original-degree monomial telescoping handles the nonlinear source before coefficient-component descent of W. Pang v1 Lemma3.1 selects a binary combination retaining half rank, with no extension-degree loss. Applies to the binary one-hot pullback of the charged quotient, not to non-Boolean Fourier variables as old Boolean variables. Provides pseudoideal memberships and preserves the original b+TB replay/cofactor budget; no smaller ordinary NS certificates or new source-map existence is asserted. Exhaustive GF8 joint-map controls and rank/missing-field controls pass.

claim.summary: F2 specialization of Elbaz-Govindasamy-Lu-Tzameret Theorem64/Corollary65: constant-depth arithmetic circuit equations of total description size s, with Boolean axioms, have a polynomial-size CNF encoding whose size-S depth-t general IPS refutation transfers to the equations with size poly(S,s) and depth O(t+Delta). General constant-depth IPS hardness for such fixed input families therefore transfers to CNFs.
claim.assessment: Attributed established import, exact F2 gate/substitution and field-equation proof scope read and reviewed. This is general degree-unrestricted IPS: no preservation of PC degree, multilinearity or Hilbert-likeness is asserted. Constant input depth, polynomial description and Boolean domains matter. No extension-field interpretation of the unary-bit notation is imported, and the restricted multilinear/ROABP lower bounds do not supply the required premise.
